title: Geotextiles - Sampling and Preparation of Test Specimens(BI-LINGUAL)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14706) covers Geotextiles - Sampling and Preparation of Test Specimens(BI-LINGUAL). This Indian Standard was adopted by the and Industrial Fabrics Sectional Committee had been approved by the Textile Division Council. This standard is technically equivalent to ISO 9862:1990 ‘Geotextiles — Sampling and Preparation of Test Specimen’ issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO). This standard has been developed simultaneously in Hindi also and hence has been published bilingually. In case of dispute in interpretation English text shall be authentic. clause_3_terminology: Sampling and Preparation of Test Specimens

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
